name: Hall Reverb
purpose: Concert-hall reverb with early reflections and a long, smooth, modulated tail; for big, spacious, expansive vocals, pads and ballads.

expose.ai_hint: Dry signal level. Keep at 100% when used as an insert.
Early reflections level: the sense of walls close by. 5-15%.
Reverb tail level. 10-20% for a vocal; 25%+ for an obviously big hall.
Hall size in metres. 15-25 small hall, 30-40 concert hall, 50+ cathedral scale.
Stereo width of the reverb. Above 100% is wider than natural.
30-60 ms keeps a vocal clear in front of a long tail.
Tail length in seconds. 1.5-2.5 s for a vocal hall, 3-5 s for huge, slow, expansive sounds.
Density of the tail. 70-90% is smooth for vocals; lower is grainier.
Raise towards 150-200 Hz to keep the reverb out of the low end.
Lower to 6000-9000 Hz to darken the tail and reduce sibilant splash.
Movement in the tail. 15-30% adds lushness; high values can sound chorused.

notes: Upstream symbol for the tail level is 'late_level'; exposed here as 'wet'. Predelay is 'delay' upstream.
Defaults come from the upstream default preset.
CPU: 1.84% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
